description.en: Pools a Vibe Code sign-in: the console completes the browser flow and mints an API key, then OpenAI and Responses traffic plus the API and Vibe monthly budgets run from the account pool.
description.zh: 把 Vibe Code 的 Mistral 登录态接入网关：浏览器登录由控制台完成，随后换取 API Key，OpenAI / Responses 与 API / Vibe 双额度都按账号池化。

docs.en: Sign-in opens the Mistral console's Vibe browser flow; when it completes the plugin polls the console and exchanges the result for an API key. Model and quota calls then use that key — nothing to paste.
docs.zh: 点击登录后会在浏览器打开 Mistral 控制台的 Vibe 登录页；完成后插件轮询控制台并把登录结果换成 API Key。之后模型与额度调用都用这个 Key，不需要再手动粘贴。

description.en: Authorize your Mistral account in the browser. Sign-in finishes as soon as the callback arrives.
description.zh: 在浏览器登录并授权 Mistral 账号，回调到达后自动完成，无需复制地址。
